svg.title: The definitions: graph/ and gui/
svg.desc: What a graph and a GUI are, whatever the language. Stand on nothing but themselves; every other layer imports them. 74 rows: each file with what it does.
svg.text: What a graph and a GUI are, whatever the language. Stand on nothing but themselves; every other layer imports them. (74 rows)
